name: app-store-rank-watch
title: App Store Rank Watch
description: Track app keyword rank snapshots on the Apple App Store and Google Play - position per keyword, version churn and category movement - each rank snapshot pulled on schedule for ASO teams and competitive app intel.

input.title: Input schema for Pry App Store Rank Watch
input.description: Track app keyword rank snapshots on the Apple App Store and Google Play - position per keyword, version churn and category movement - each rank snapshot pulled on schedule for ASO teams and competitive app intel.

change_threshold.title: Change threshold
change_threshold.description: SimHash bit distance above this counts as changed (0 = any difference, 3 default, 10+ only major rewrites).

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

keywords.title: Keywords to track
keywords.description: Keyword list; each store page is checked per keyword.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
